Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: When opening the 2015 Kungahuset page about Prince Nicolas’s birth, WebSurfer reported the line “med anledning av att Prinsessan Sofia har fått en son,” which is incorrect for Nicolas’s birth announcement (it should reference Princess Madeleine). This misread/mis-extracted content could mislead the identification of the mother and represents the first factual error in the workflow, even though later steps corrected the understanding.
